title: Lions
text:
Lions are big wild cats. They live in Africa. Lions live in groups. A group of lions is called a pride.

Lions sleep for many hours each day. At night, they hunt for food. They hunt zebras and other animals. Lions are strong and fast.

questions.text: What do lions hunt at night?
Why do lions sleep for many hours each day?
options: They are afraid of the night
They need rest to save energy
They do not like the sun
Because they are strong and fast

vocabulary.definition: a number of animals or people together
to look for and catch animals for food
having a lot of power or energy

paragraph_translations: Leões são grandes gatos selvagens. Eles vivem na África. Leões vivem em grupos. Um grupo de leões é chamado de bando.
Leões dormem muitas horas por dia. À noite, eles caçam comida. Eles caçam zebras e outros animais. Leões são fortes e rápidos.
